name: swarm-cursors
description: Reconstruct a live DOM with a coordinated swarm of animated cursors.

scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap --outDir dist/types && pnpm exec esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2020 --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.js && pnpm exec esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2020 --format=cjs --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.cjs
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:subpaths
